speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (Non-classic or Late-presenting). The history of partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth indicates congenital virilization, while the current presentation of delayed menarche, severe acne, and bone fractures is consistent with chronic hyperandrogenism and secondary amenorrhea due to adrenal or ovarian dysfunction. REQUEST TEST: 17-hydroxyprogesterone, DHEA-S, and Androstenedione levels.
